_about: Generated by hardware/cad/build_assembly.py. Assembly-frame data for the 3D viewer; not print files (see hardware/stl/).
frame: Z-up, mm, Z=0 = top face of the box lid. "axis" parts have X=Y=0 on the shaft axis and are moved to shaft_axis_xy; "world" parts are already in the assembly frame.
servo_rotation: Disc angle = open_dir_deg - 270 + servo_deg: at servo 180° the disc local +Y (its opening) points at layout.disc_v3.open_dir_deg, towards the chute.

parts.name: Rotating disc
parts.description: 103 mm disc in the bowl with a trapezoid opening. Turning it 180° lets one portion drop. A sleeve under it ends in a labyrinth cap over the bushing collar. It sits on the shaft hex and is clamped by an M3x50 screw.

parts.name: Shaft and hub
parts.description: 22 mm hub with the 25-tooth socket for the servo spline and a 45° top cone, a 12 mm shaft with grooves for 9x2 O-rings, and an 8 mm hex at the top that drives the disc. Print at 100 % infill.

parts.name: Sealed bushing and servo cradle
parts.description: One part. It carries the shaft through the lid, sealed by a 45x2 face O-ring under the lid and a 9x2 O-ring on the shaft, and hangs the servo from the lid on four pads with heat-set inserts. Designed, not printed or mounted yet: the prototype still uses a wall bracket.

parts.name: Chute
parts.description: Curved hollow duct bolted to the bowl spout. It carries the portion out and down. Print orientation not validated yet.

context.name: Kibble container
context.description: Any container that holds the kibble above the hopper. Shape shown is a placeholder.

context.name: Hopper and shelf
context.description: Funnels the kibble into the bowl and seats on the bowl rim. Not designed yet.

context.name: Bowl with spout
context.description: A reused round chamber with a tangential spout. It sits on the lid; the disc turns inside it and the chute bolts to the spout.

context.name: Servo, 25 kg·cm
context.description: Digital servo with a 25-tooth spline (DS3218 / DS3225 class). In the design it hangs from the lid in the cradle of passante_culla and turns the shaft; the prototype still holds it in a wall bracket.

context.name: ESP32 board and 12 V input
context.description: ESP32 board (Freenove ESP32-WROVER as documented; to be verified on the device) running the MicroPython firmware drives the servo. The planned design takes power from an external 12 V adapter through a cable gland; prototype 1 runs on a 5 V bench supply. Position in the box is indicative.

context.name: Waterproof box
context.description: 265 x 185 mm sealed box. The lid is the reference plane (Z = 0); in the exploded view only the base moves.

not_shown.name: Spline fit test
not_shown.description: Three short coupons with the 25-tooth socket at 0.05, 0.10 and 0.20 mm clearance. Print these first and try them on the servo.

servo.mounting: appeso al coperchio tramite culla integrata nel passante (niente mount a parete)

spout.note: tangential spout of the reused bowl, approximate
